name: tuck human flag
description: A human flag hold with the knees pulled in, which shortens the lever. It is the first true horizontal flag position.
instructions: Take your flag grip on a vertical pole with both arms straight.
Kick up into the vertical flag position.
Tuck your knees and lower your hips until your torso is level.
Push hard with the bottom arm and pull with the top arm.
Hold, then lower your feet with control and switch sides.
